name: Curry Dip
description: A flavorful and spicy dip made with mayonnaise, curry powder, and chili sauce, perfect for serving with snacks.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl until well combined.
Let stand in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours before serving to allow flavors to meld.

keywords: curry dip, spicy dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Crab & Cheese Platter
_similar.description: A layered seafood appetizer featuring a creamy cheese base topped with cocktail sauce and crab meat.
recipeIngredient: 2 large packages (8 oz each) cream cheese

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together the cream cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise and onion flakes in a blender, or beat with an electric mixer, until smooth and creamy.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over the surface of a large round platter, leaving room around the outside for a row of crackers.
Press the centre of the cheese mixture down lightly to make a slightly raised border, about ½ to 1 in wide, around the outer edge.
Spread seafood cocktail sauce over the cheese layer within this border, leaving an outside rim of the cheese layer showing.
Drain the crab meat and spread it over the sauce layer, again leaving a border of seafood sauce showing.
Serve with crackers or vegetables.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, layered platter, seafood appetizer

_similar.name: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms
_similar.description: A savory appetizer featuring large mushrooms filled with a crab meat and cheese mixture, baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup grated Emmenthal or Gruyère cheese, divided

recipeInstructions.text: Wipe mushrooms with lemon juice. Remove stems for stuffing and set caps aside.
Trim and chop stems. In a saucepan, melt butter. Add onion and chopped mushroom stems. Cook until mushroom stems are tender and moisture has evaporated.
Stir in drained crab meat, 1/4 cup cheese, 1 tablespoon cracker crumbs, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix well.
Spoon stuffing into mushroom caps and place on greased baking dish.
Combine remaining 1/4 cup cheese and 1 teaspoon cracker crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over stuffed mushrooms.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Bake in 400°F oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve hot.

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Zesty BBQ Sauce
_similar.description: A tangy and spicy BBQ sauce with ketchup, vinegar, and a kick of cayenne pepper, great for grilling.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Blend and bring to a boil, stirring until sugar has dissolved.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Refrigerate or freeze for later use.

_similar.keywords: BBQ sauce, zesty, spicy, grilling sauce

_similar.name: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops
_similar.description: Pork chops marinated in a barbecue sauce and baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Trim fat from pork chops and place in a single layer in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine ketchup, onions, garlic, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, mustard, and oregano in a bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chops and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours.
Cover with foil and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake, spooning sauce over chops occasionally, for 15 to 30 minutes or until tender.
